source_attributes.description: UW-LITMUS-CarotidRF High frame rate in vivo carotid artery acquisition made using us4r. See annotations for details on anatomy, view, and condition.

acquisition.time_reference_evidence: Recorded t0_delays equal t_ref + element_position.dot(n_tx)/c; maximum residual 7.76e-6 samples. Initial A/D time is recorded separately. Known moving-point test verifies the DAS phase convention.
acquisition.receive_aperture_evidence: Pinned Acq0 attributes identify us4r; raw has 128 simultaneous channels, full apodization and 2 logical transmits. Provider documents receive multiplexing for us4r-lite acquisitions.
acquisition.amplitude_processing: hardware gain retained; no frame normalization
acquisition.baseline: coherent mean of embedded uncompounded views
acquisition.beamformer: CPU far-field plane-wave DAS, normal receive; experimental phase validation pending

output_claim: processing path and numerical diagnostics; no separation accuracy claim
